Manufacturing

From raw materials to finished goods. Track production, control quality, and know your true cost — without a separate manufacturing system.

Your challenges

Production visibility

You cannot see what is on the production line right now — what stage each order is at, which materials have been consumed, or what the yield looks like until the batch is complete.

Quality consistency

Quality checks happen, but they are recorded on paper or in someone's notebook. When a batch has a problem, tracing back to the raw materials and production conditions takes days.

True cost unknown

You know what you paid for raw materials, but the actual cost per unit — including labour, overhead, and waste — is calculated after the fact in a spreadsheet, if at all.

Material planning

Production stops because a raw material ran out. Nobody saw it coming because stock levels were checked manually and reorder points were in someone's head.

How Kraal Code helps

Recipe / BOM Management

Define bills of materials with ingredients, quantities, expected yields, and processing steps. Version control tracks recipe changes over time.

Production Orders

Create production orders against recipes. Track from planned to started to completed. Materials are consumed and finished goods received automatically.

Quality Control

Define inspection templates with checkpoints and acceptance criteria. Record results per batch. Approve or reject based on findings. Only certified batches move to finished goods.

Yield Analysis

Compare planned vs actual yields. Track waste, scrap, and by-products. Identify inefficiencies by recipe, work centre, or time period.

Raw Material Tracking

Materials are reserved on production order creation and consumed on completion. Reorder alerts trigger before stock runs out. No more production stops from missing inputs.

Cost of Production

Labour, materials, and overhead costs accumulated per production order. COGS posted to the general ledger automatically. Know your true cost per unit.
